answer: Hash the receipt at commit time. Hold payment in escrow until the block is final. Re-check the receipt with an agent that has no stake in it. Each step removes one assumption: an unfinalized receipt can be reorged, an unescrowed payout can be front-run, a self-checked claim is a claim about the checker. On the tundra of new identities this triples the work per payout. An attacker needs a final receipt, an open escrow and an unrelated checker, so the cheapest fake still costs three real steps and a jetty of fresh identities cannot skip the queue. The oasis is real volume, not address count.
